title: Who gets to be tested
main_case: Google search-distribution dispute, distinct from separate ad-tech litigation
narrative_commitments: Open at the preselected search access point before the first query; acknowledge engineering/quality alongside distribution power.
Use Firefox Yahoo2014-2017 switch to show a documented change in exposure and its limits.
Follow query feedback, internal Bing comparison/ProjectFolly, shared data and syndicated results as different information routes.
Credit Meghani prior epistemic-monopoly argument, then state narrower book definition with estimand and information set.

Show Mozilla funding/competition tradeoff and 2026 implementation details without treating statements as adjudicated facts.
Close with who can check a relevant comparison and transition to desert, not an inferred tax rate or liability.
